topics.topic: Identity and relationship of the service's deployment route
questions: Is there one deployment route shared by this service and the Client Portal, or does each have a separate route that follows the same policy?
Is this the same Factory deployment route used by the Client Portal, a separate route implementing the same policy, or the service's HTTPS route mentioned by R0-16?
Is this the Factory deployment gate, another deployment pipeline, the service's HTTPS host route, or a route shared with the Client Portal?

quotes:
Before each deployment every distribution installed
   in the image is checked against a snapshot of the OSV database, ecosystem PyPI, that the deployment route accepts
   as current. That route owns the age limit, and no code of this service reads it. Any known vulnerability listed for an installed version
   blocks the deployment, whatever its severity, and a check that cannot complete does not pass.
   This is the policy the Client Portal already follows.
The check of rule 2 is built: it is the deployment route of this service, as it is the Client Portal's.
judgement.divergence: One implementation uses the Client Portal's existing deployment route and its age limit; another gives this service a separate deployment route with an independently owned age limit, so the deployment operator observes different admission decisions.
judgement.why: The phrase “as it is the Client Portal's” does not decide whether it identifies one shared route or two routes following the same policy.

witness.initial: A service image is checked against a snapshot accepted by a service-specific age limit but rejected by the Client Portal route's age limit.
events: The deployment route checks the service image before deployment.
outcomes: The shared Client Portal route refuses the image under the Portal's age limit.
The separate service route admits the image under its independently owned age limit.
basis:
Before each deployment every distribution installed
   in the image is checked against a snapshot of the OSV database, ecosystem PyPI, that the deployment route accepts
   as current. That route owns the age limit, and no code of this service reads it.
The check of rule 2 is built: it is the deployment route of this service, as it is the Client Portal's.

topics.topic: Whether all deployments must use the named route and how bypasses are prevented
questions: Must every deployment be admitted exclusively through the named route, or may another deployment mechanism admit an image after independently performing all checks in rule 2?
Must every deployment be admitted only through this route, and what prevents a manual or alternative deployment from bypassing the check?
Must every possible deployment be admitted through this route, or is using the route only the prescribed procedure while another deployment path may exist?
